caption: The drawing depicts a large, exaggerated head of a puppet or ventriloquist's dummy facing directly forward against a plain, light-colored background. The head has a brownish-tan color with darker shading to suggest contours and texture, including some subtle cracks and scrapes. The puppet has thick black eyebrows, large protruding round eyes with black pupils surrounded by white and some darker areas around the sockets, and a broad, flattened nose with deep nostrils. The mouth is oversized with bright, shiny red lips and a pronounced, curved shape, showing a separation at the corners for a moveable jaw. Two thin black strings are attached to the top sides of the head, implying control or manipulation, and another red element resembling a collar is visible at the base of the head. The artist's name, "E. WEIMER," is written in small lettering in the lower left corner.
title: Marionette (Detail)
